SegmentType.description:
Structural type of a Tier-0 SourceSegment, per
docs/efficiency-and-processing-architecture.md -- created programmatically from
existing document structure, never by an LLM.
SegmentType.title: SegmentType

description:
A Tier-0 structural segment, created programmatically from existing document
structure -- never by an LLM. Offsets and provenance are always preserved
(docs/efficiency-and-processing-architecture.md §5).

char_start.description: Always present -- character offsets are always computable.
char_start.title: Char Start

cross_reference_targets.description: Raw Tier-2 pattern matches (e.g. 'Section 4.2') -- not resolved to ids.
cross_reference_targets.title: Cross Reference Targets

legal_annex_identifier.description: Set only when this segment's document contains an explicit 'Annex <roman numeral>' title paragraph, carried forward the same way as legal_article_number.
legal_annex_identifier.title: Legal Annex Identifier

legal_article_number.description: Set only when this segment's document contains an explicit 'Article <N>' title paragraph, carried forward to later segments in the same document. Never inferred from source_document_id/filename -- see docs/cross-reference-granularity-resolution-plan.md §4.
legal_article_number.title: Legal Article Number

legal_paragraph_number.description: Set only when this segment's own leading marker (or, for a carried-forward continuation/point, the most recent preceding marker in document order) is an explicit bare-number list marker ('1. ', '2. ', ...) -- never inferred from position/filename alone.
legal_paragraph_number.title: Legal Paragraph Number

legal_point_identifier.description: Set only when this segment's own text begins with an explicit '(<letter>) ' marker. Always paired with whatever legal_paragraph_number is in force at that point.
legal_point_identifier.title: Legal Point Identifier

token_start.description: Present only when a tokenizer actually ran; never inferred from char offsets.
token_start.title: Token Start

title: SourceSegment
